
# Project Instructions

You are assisting with a Python Flask Sudoku application.

## Coding Standards
- Write clean, readable and maintainable code.
- Use meaningful variable and function names.
- Follow Python PEP 8 standards.
- Use modular and reusable functions.
- Avoid unnecessary duplicate code.
- Add comments where necessary.

## Project Architecture
- Keep backend logic separate from frontend logic.
- Use Flask for backend functionality.
- Use HTML, CSS and JavaScript for the frontend.
- Keep Sudoku game logic separate from Flask routes.
- Organize files logically.

## Sudoku Requirements
- Support Easy, Medium and Hard difficulties.
- Ensure every generated puzzle has exactly one unique solution.
- Validate Sudoku rows, columns and 3x3 boxes.
- Provide immediate feedback for incorrect entries.
- Include Hint and Check functionality.
- Display a completion message when solved.

## Additional Features
- Add a timer.
- Maintain a Top 10 fastest-times leaderboard.
- Store leaderboard information in browser localStorage.
- Include a Dark Mode and Light Mode toggle.
- Make the interface responsive.

## Testing
- Use pytest for testing.
- Test existing functionality before refactoring.
- Run tests after every major change.
- Do not remove existing working features without reason.

Explain important changes and ask for approval before major modifications.
